name: Plate solving (Astrometry.net)
description: Find where a photo of the night sky points. Uploads the chosen image to Astrometry.net, waits for the solution in the background, then marks the named stars and objects it identified and reports the field's centre, scale and rotation.

descriptionI18n.zh-TW: 找出夜空照片拍的是天空的哪個位置。把選定的圖片上傳到 Astrometry.net，在背景等候解算，完成後標出辨識到的恆星與天體，並回報視野中心、比例尺與旋轉角。

network.dataFlow: The whole image you choose is uploaded to nova.astrometry.net (marked private on that site), together with your API key. Nothing else leaves this server.

secrets.name: api_key
secrets.label: Astrometry.net API key
secrets.description: From your profile on nova.astrometry.net. Set by the server administrator.

capabilities.title: Solve a star field
capabilities.description: Upload the canvas's image to Astrometry.net and find where in the sky it points. Runs in the background (30 s to a few minutes): returns a job id, check it with get_module_job. When done, named objects are marked on the canvas and the job holds centre RA/Dec, scale, rotation and radius. Scale or position hints help.

scaleLowArcsecPerPixel.description: Smallest plausible scale, arcsec per pixel (give both low and high)

scaleHighArcsecPerPixel.description: Largest plausible scale, arcsec per pixel

centerRa.description: Rough RA of the field centre in degrees (give with centerDec and radiusDeg)

centerDec.description: Rough Dec of the field centre in degrees

radiusDeg.description: How far from that centre the field can be, degrees

showCard.description: Show the result fact sheet (centre, size, scale, links) open to the user (default true). false keeps it folded away; the user can bring it back from the canvas panel. Use false when the user only wants the marks.

examples.description: a wide-field photo, 60 to 200 arcsec per pixel

profile.whenToUse: A photo of the night sky (stars visible, not heavily edited) when you need to know where it points, or to name the stars and objects in it.
profile.whenNotToUse: Daytime or indoor photos, drawings or stock images with composited stars, images with very few stars, or when the user does not want the image sent to an outside service.
profile.inputLimits: JPEG or PNG stored on this server, up to 25 MB. Scale hints (arcsec per pixel, both ends) and a rough position make solving faster and more reliable.

cost.resource: One upload and a queue on nova.astrometry.net's free service; stops after 15 minutes.

dataFlow.sends: The whole image and the administrator's API key go to nova.astrometry.net; the image is marked private there.

reliability.note: A successful solve is a strong match against star catalogs; named objects come from its catalogs. Wide lenses and unflipped assumptions can shift the orientation.
reliability.verify: Check that a few marked stars sit on the right stars; compare the field size with the lens.

fallbacks.then: Retry with a scale range from the lens and sensor, or with a rough position; use a sharper, less processed or less cropped photo.

fallbacks.when: the key is refused or missing
fallbacks.then: Ask the administrator to set it (secret set); do not guess positions from the picture alone.

fallbacks.when: the user will not send the image
fallbacks.then: Identify bright stars by eye and label them as unverified suggestions.

zh-TW.whenToUse: 夜空照片（看得到星星、沒有過度後製），想知道它拍的是天空哪裡，或想標出裡面的恆星與天體。
zh-TW.whenNotToUse: 白天或室內照片、合成星空的圖片、星星太少的圖，或使用者不想把圖片傳到外部服務時。
zh-TW.inputLimits: 存放在這台伺服器的 JPEG 或 PNG，最大 25 MB。給比例尺範圍（兩端都要，單位 arcsec/像素）與大概位置能讓解算更快更可靠。

cost.resource: 在 nova.astrometry.net 的免費服務上傳並排隊；15 分鐘後會停止。

dataFlow.sends: 整張圖片與管理員的 API 金鑰會送到 nova.astrometry.net，圖片在該站設為不公開。

reliability.note: 解算成功代表與星表有很強的吻合；標出的天體名稱來自它的星表。廣角鏡頭可能讓方向有偏差。
reliability.verify: 檢查幾顆標記是否真的落在對應的星上，並用鏡頭資料核對視野大小。

fallbacks.then: 依鏡頭與感光元件給比例尺範圍，或給大概位置再試；換一張更清晰、後製與裁切更少的照片。
請管理員設定金鑰（secret set），不要只憑圖片猜位置。
用肉眼辨認亮星，並標明是未經驗證的建議。

capabilities.title: Show the field on an all-sky map

titleI18n.zh-TW: 畫出視野在全天的位置

capabilities.description: Draw an all-sky map (RA/Dec grid) with the solved field outlined, from the centre and size a solve returned. Needs no network. Without a canvas a new blank canvas is made. The outline is approximate: it ignores lens distortion and image flipping.

raDeg.description: Field centre RA in degrees (raDeg from solve_field)

fieldHeightDeg.description: Field height in degrees (default the width)

rotationDeg.description: Up is this many degrees east of north (rotationDeg from solve_field)

profile.whenToUse: After a solve, to show where the field lies on the whole sky.
profile.whenNotToUse: When you need an exact footprint: the outline ignores lens distortion and image flipping.
profile.inputLimits: Needs the field centre (RA 0-360, Dec -90..90); size and rotation default to a small unrotated field.

reliability.note: The centre is exact as given; the outline is an approximation.
reliability.verify: Compare with the Astrometry.net result page's sky plot.

fallbacks.when: the field crosses the map edge at RA 180
fallbacks.then: Only its centre is drawn; say so, and give the RA/Dec range in words.

zh-TW.whenToUse: 解算完成後，顯示視野在整個天球上的位置。
zh-TW.whenNotToUse: 需要精確的視野範圍時：外框不含鏡頭畸變與影像翻轉。
zh-TW.inputLimits: 需要視野中心（赤經 0–360、赤緯 -90 到 90）；大小與旋轉省略時用小而未旋轉的視野。

cost.resource: 只在這台伺服器上計算。

dataFlow.sends: 沒有任何資料離開伺服器。

reliability.note: 中心位置依你給的值；外框是近似。
reliability.verify: 對照 Astrometry.net 結果頁的天球位置圖。

fallbacks.when: 視野跨過地圖在赤經 180 的邊緣
fallbacks.then: 只畫中心點；要說明這點，並用文字說出赤經赤緯範圍。
